name: EveryAction
description: EveryAction is a nonprofit and organizing CRM for constituent records, fundraising, advocacy, canvassing, events, volunteer engagement and digital programs.
agentUseSummary: Add a client-requested EveryAction application name and context-bound API key, then run 217 current official non-payment operations through pinned routes. Safe runs 123 GET reads directly and requires approval for 94 non-GET operations; the separate-host PCI payment route remains blocked in every policy.

credentialRequirements.label: EveryAction application name
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the application name paired with the client-requested EveryAction API key. Relay sends it only as the Basic-auth username to api.securevan.com.

credentialRequirements.label: EveryAction API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a client-requested production key for the intended My Voters or My Campaign database. Relay encrypts it and sends it only as the Basic-auth password to api.securevan.com.

providerSetup.blocker: Live acceptance requires an authorized EveryAction client, a production API key requested by that client, its paired application name, the intended My Voters or My Campaign database context, suitable permissions and representative records.
providerSetup.nextAction: The authorized client requests and stores a least-privilege production key and paired application name through Relay Console, then validates reads, approved reversible mutations, database-context isolation, throttling, credential replacement/deletion, disconnect and post-disconnect denial in Railway staging.

evidence.supports: The official current API reference documents 218 routes under the v4 securevan API; Relay pins 217 after excluding the separate payment route.
EveryAction uses HTTP Basic authentication with the application name as username and a database-context API key as password.
Production keys are requested by the authorized client, inherit sandbox permissions and must be protected like passwords.
Payment processing uses a separate payments-api.securevan.com origin and handles card or EFT data with PCI responsibilities, so Relay blocks it.
